## 2. Land Surveying Comparison Matrix (Unique Survey)

| Survey Method | Typical Accuracy | Best Used For | Instruments Deployed | Standard Deliverables | Turnaround |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Counter Survey (Contour)** | ±2–5 mm vertical (RL) | Cut-fill earthwork, drainage slopes, grading | Total Station + Auto Level / DGPS | AutoCAD `.DWG`/`.DXF` contours (0.25m–1m), 3D TIN, Cut-Fill Excel | 1–3 Days |
| **Land Topography Survey** | ±2–5 mm positional | Architectural planning, factory/TP as-built maps | Reflectorless Total Station + RTK DGPS | Full `.DWG` feature plan, spot RLs, trees/utilities, `.KMZ` | 1–4 Days |
| **Point Marking & Demarcation** | ±5–10 mm (RTK / TS) | 7/12 & TP boundary verification, corner pegging | Dual-Freq RTK DGPS + Total Station | Steel pegs/stone pillars, corner UTM table, record overlay | 1–2 Days |
| **DGPS & RTK Geodetic Survey** | ±8 mm + 1 ppm RTK | 5–500+ acre sites, solar parks, TBM fixing | Multi-Constellation GNSS Base & Rover | Permanent TBM pillars, WGS-84/UTM table, `.SHP` & `.DWG` | 1–3 Days |
| **Drone / UAV Aerial Mapping** | 2–5 cm GSD (with GCP) | Townships, quarries, stockpiles, floodplains | Mapping UAV + DGPS Ground Control Points | Orthomosaic GeoTIFF, DSM/DTM/DEM, `.LAS` point cloud | 2–5 Days |
| **Road / Pipeline Alignment** | ±2–3 mm level | Highways, canals, sewer/water corridors, ROW | Total Station + Digital Level + DGPS | L-Section & X-Section (10m/20m intervals), Mass Haul sheet | 2–5 Days |

## 4. Technical Key Facts & Direct Answers

### Counter Survey (Contour Survey) — https://uecivil.com/guides/contour-survey-cut-fill-guide
- **Definition**: Connects ground points of equal Reduced Level (RL) at 0.25m, 0.5m, or 1.0m contour intervals.
- **Note on Regional Terminology**: In Gujarat, "Counter Survey" is a standard term used interchangeably with "Contour Survey."
- **Primary Outputs**: AutoCAD `.DWG`/`.DXF` contour drawings, spot level grids (5m–15m spacing), 3D TIN surfaces, and Cut & Fill earthwork volume calculation sheets.

### Point Marking & 7/12 Revenue Demarcation — https://uecivil.com/guides/point-marking-7-12-demarcation-gujarat
- **Purpose**: Superimposes official Gujarat revenue maps (Village Form 7/12, Tippan, DILR measurement sheets, Town Planning Final Plot maps) over live RTK DGPS / Total Station measurements.
- **Result**: Identifies exact possession excess/shortage and fixes physical corner markers to prevent boundary disputes.

### Compression Testing Machine (CTM 2000kN vs 3000kN) — https://uecivil.com/guides/compression-testing-machine-ctm-buyer-guide
- **2000 kN CTM**: Covers standard 150×150×150 mm concrete cubes up to ~M75–M80 grade for building sites, RMC plants, and PWD labs.
- **3000 kN CTM**: Recommended for high-strength concrete (M80–M110+), bridge girders, metro/highway QA labs, and NABL-accredited laboratories.
- **IS:516 Loading Rate**: ~140 kg/cm²/min (~5.2 kN/sec on a 150 mm cube) with ±1% indication accuracy per IS:14858.

### Turnkey Lab Setup Packages — https://uecivil.com/guides/civil-engineering-lab-setup-checklist-india
- **Building Site Lab**: 2000kN CTM, 150mm Cube Moulds, Slump Cone, IS Sieves, Hot Air Oven, Auto Level.
- **Highway / NHAI Lab**: 3000kN CTM, Soil CBR, Proctor, Core Cutter, Bitumen Penetrometer, Softening Point, Ductility, Marshall Stability, Total Station.
- **Quotations**: Available via Cart Enquiry on `https://uecivil.com/products`, phone/WhatsApp `+91 90991 60391`, or email `info@uecivil.com`.
